audience: businesses that send contracts and documents for e-signature with Signaturit

useCases.title: Count and track signature requests
useCases.text: Count the signature requests by status and sent date. List the requests and open one to see which signers have not signed.

useCases.title: Send a reminder to signers who have not signed
useCases.text: Find the pending signature request, then send a reminder email to its signers. The signers are third parties who receive the email.

useCases.title: Cancel a request that is no longer needed
useCases.text: Read the signature request, then cancel it. The signers can no longer sign the document, and a cancellation cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Keep signing contacts up to date
useCases.text: List the saved contacts. Create, update or delete a contact with its name and email. A deletion cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Check credits and signature templates
useCases.text: Read the used and remaining credits of the account, by type and period. List the signature templates of the account.
